# sidecar-k8s

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-suite-readme.sh from juju/juju tests at a4e2f02a2931351e25f7d3aef0d331d02a6a0c56 (v4.0.15); edit skips.txt / alone.txt / notes.md, not this file. -->

- **What:** juju/juju `tests/main.sh -l "$LAB_CONTROLLER" -c microk8s sidecar` against the lab controller (`SUBSTRATE=k8s`, `DEPS=charmcraft`).
- **Tests** (from `suites/sidecar/task.sh` at `a4e2f02a2931`, v4.0.15):
  - `test_deploy_and_remove_application`
  - `test_deploy_and_force_remove_application`
  - `test_pebble_notices`
  - `test_pebble_checks`
  - `test_credential_get_k8s`
  - `test_rootless` (run_non_root_charm, run_sudoer_charm)

- **Deps:** `DEPS=charmcraft` (4.x/stable). `test_rootless` packs `sidecar-non-root` and `sidecar-sudoer` from `testcharms/` and checks for charmcraft first. Without it the run is a `setup-error` ("Missing dependencies: charmcraft", run 38907759017). charmcraft packs in an LXD instance, so on this k8s runner the harness also sets up LXD when `DEPS` has charmcraft (#8; before that fix, run 38910641303 failed).
- **4.1/edge:** `fail` in `test_pebble_notices` (run 38917856456), a juju facade-versioning bug that the 4.1/edge version skew exposes. juju/juju #23365 (4.1, 2026-10-14) added `SSHServerPort` to the *existing* Controller facade v15 (register.go: "v15 adds SSHServerHostKey and SSHServerPort") instead of a v16. The 4.1/edge client (snap r36731, git f17f1c5, 2026-10-16) therefore calls it on a controller that also reports v15 without it: image `jujud-operator:4.1-beta3`, agent-git-commit 4d3ea36 (2026-10-05, 439 commits behind). With a v16 the client's own facade check would have refused cleanly; instead `juju ssh --container` fails with `unknown method "SSHServerPort" at version 15 for facade type "Controller"`. Candidate upstream report (not filed). No skip: 4.0/stable passes.
- **Setup-phase caveat (triage):** `suite.sh` treats output before the first `===> [   ] Running:` as the setup phase, and here only `test_rootless` uses `run`, so 5 of the 6 tests (each `ensure controller-model-sidecar` … `destroy_model`, which never fails) run inside it. A destroy that errors or hangs in one of them makes the next `ensure` print "already exists. Use the following to clean up the environment:" before any marker, which is scored `setup-error`. Until the harness fix (setup phase ends at the second `Reusing bootstrapped juju` line, #9) is merged, triage a sidecar-k8s `setup-error` naming `controller-model-sidecar` as `fail`.
- **Note:** no skips. k8s only (the suite skips itself on non-k8s providers). Only `test_rootless` uses `run`, so the `] Success:` lines come from it. The other tests deploy sidecar charms from CharmHub directly.
- **Teardown check:** after a pass, `scripts/no-models-left.sh` requires every non-controller model of every user (`juju models --all`) to be gone within 10 min, else `fail`. Between iterations (`repeat`) `cleanup-models.sh` destroys every user's models by qualified name. `run.sh` exports `DESTROY_TIMEOUT=5m` (main.sh default 15m) and `TIMEOUT_MIN` keeps 10 min for this check, so a hung destroy scores `fail`, not `error`.
- **No test ran:** `suite.sh` turns a main.sh exit 0 without any `] Success:` line into 3 (`inconclusive`).
- **Expected verdict:** `pass` on a healthy channel.

- **Budget:** `TIMEOUT_MIN=35` per iteration (calibration: `docs/calibration.md`).
